name: Barbell Low-Bar Back Squat
steps: Set the barbell across your rear delts below the shoulder ridge, unrack, and stand shoulder-width apart with toes slightly turned out.
Take a deep breath, brace your core tightly, and lock your upper back firm.
Bend your hips and knees together, allowing your torso to incline while the bar stays over your midfoot.
Drive upward through your midfoot and heels while keeping your hips and chest rising smoothly together.
tips: Keep the bar balanced directly over the middle of your feet throughout the squat.
Keep your wrists straight over the bar so your upper back rather than your elbows carries the load.
